title: KU Engineering to host 58th Annual Geotechnical Engineering Conference
summary_en: On Nov. 12, the University of Kansas Department of Civil, Environmental & Architectural Engineering will host experts in the field of geotechnical engineering for a conference exploring the latest developments in the field.
title_cn: KU Engineering to host 58th Annual Geotechnical Engineering Conference

title: KU launches Higher Learning Commission Accreditation 2029 mid-cycle review
summary_en: In a little more than two years, the University of Kansas will undergo evaluation by the Higher Learning Commission (HLC) to verify the institution continues to meet accreditation standards. On Oct. 6, members from various KU campuses met in the Kansas Union to formally begin the process.
title_cn: KU launches Higher Learning Commission Accreditation 2029 mid-cycle review
